title: "Waiting for an action server to become available" in ros2 action send_goal, and rclpy action results that never arrive: causes and fixes, measured
excerpt: Wrong name, namespace, remap, wrong type, other ROS_DOMAIN_ID, a server that never spins, rejected, canceled or killed goals, --timeout, discovery delay, and rclpy executor deadlocks in callbacks. Measured with rclpy on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
